candidates.change_summary: Remove the assignment _BASE_TARGET_ = _BASE_RESERVE_; from the BELOW_ONE branch so the base target is not reset when the state is corrected.
Remove the assignment _BASE_TARGET_ = _BASE_RESERVE_; from the ABOVE_ONE branch so the base target is not reset when that state is corrected.

Flip the first branch's condition from _BASE_RESERVE_ < _BASE_TARGET_ to _BASE_RESERVE_ > _BASE_TARGET_, so the reset happens in the opposite reserve/target situation and the base target changes differently after correctRState.
In the BELOW_ONE branch, set _BASE_TARGET_ = _QUOTE_RESERVE_ instead of _BASE_RESERVE_, changing the observable base target after correctRState whenever quote reserve differs from base reserve.
